seo.title: Accounting
seo.seo_title: AI accounting pre-entry for small business
seo.seo_description: The system reads your documents, prepares the pre-entry, flags discrepancies and leaves the decision to your accountant. Bank reconciliation is not delivered.

translation.headline: Pre-entry ready. The accountant decides.
translation.subheadline: The system reads your documents, prepares the pre-entry and flags discrepancies. Your accountant reviews, corrects and approves: the AI prepares, it does not book.

blocks.role: Problème : un cabinet comptable en fin de mois.

translation.title: Month-end means data entry.
translation.body:
A small accounting firm receives invoices, expense reports and statements from its clients, in every possible form. A large share of month-end time goes to rereading amounts and retyping lines, rather than advising.

The example is constructed to illustrate the principle; it is not a customer's result.

items.title: Checks to repeat.
items.text: Pre-tax amounts, taxes and total must agree.

items.title: Advisory time lost.
items.text: What the client really pays for is the accountant's judgment.

blocks.role: Ce que fait le système : lecture, contrôles de cohérence, table, relecture.

translation.title: What the system does.
translation.intro: The accountant defines the fields and the checking rules; the system applies them document by document.

cards.title: It reads the documents.
cards.text: Invoices, quotes, purchase orders, expense reports: starter templates exist for these four types.

cards.title: It checks.
cards.text: It verifies that pre-tax amounts and taxes add up to the total, to within a few cents, and marks doubtful documents.

cards.title: It prepares.
cards.text: One pre-entry line per document, with the fields agreed with the accountant (category, supplier, project).

cards.title: It waits.
cards.text: The accountant reviews the lines, corrects and approves. Nothing is recorded before.

blocks.role: Ce que reçoit l'équipe, bénéfice, et OPSYS-AI pour la construction.

translation.title: What your team receives.
translation.body:
A table of documents ready for review, with discrepancies first. The expected benefit: less retyping and errors caught sooner. No quantified gain is announced; it is measured during a pilot, on your own files.

For construction companies, OPSYS-AI goes further: its in-house finance department (M5) prepares a draft invoice after the work and tracks receivables. That department is in pilot, and neither sending invoices nor payroll calculation is delivered.

items.title: A pre-entry table.
items.text: One row per document, with the “to verify” flag.

items.title: The reasons for discrepancies.
items.text: Missing field, unreadable value, total that does not add up.

items.title: A file reviewed, not rekeyed.
items.text: The accountant spends time on judgment.

blocks.role: Ce qui reste sous contrôle, et ce qui n'est pas livré (rapprochement bancaire).

cards.title: The accountant keeps the decision.
cards.text: No entry is recorded without their approval.

cards.title: No bank link.
cards.text: Bank reconciliation is not delivered in WorkStudio. It can be studied as custom work, from statements you export, without any connection to your bank.

cards.title: Your software, to be qualified.
cards.text: Posting to your accounting software goes through a connector qualified during the diagnosis, package by package.

cards.title: Your tax rules.
cards.text: The starter templates are general. Quebec taxes, categories and chart of accounts are defined with you and checked on your documents.

cards.title: No accounting advice.
cards.text: The system prepares and checks; it does not advise. Decisions remain your accountant's.

blocks.role: FAQ propre à la solution comptabilité.

items.question: Does the AI do the bookkeeping?
items.answer: No. It prepares the pre-entry and flags discrepancies. Entries and decisions remain your accountant's.

items.question: Can bank reconciliation be automated?
items.answer: Not with a product delivered today. A custom study is possible, from exported statements, without a bank connection.

items.question: Does my accountant have to change tools?
items.answer: In principle, no: the pre-entry is filed in a table, and what follows depends on the software they use, which we qualify with them.

items.question: Do my documents leave my server?
items.answer: Not if reading is done with a model on your server. An external reading service is possible, only with your written agreement, and it is disclosed.

translation.title: Let's talk about your month-end.
translation.text: Describe your documents and your software. We will tell you what gets prepared, what connects and what stays with your accountant.
